Each game can turn a rule on or off in its options, whatever the rule's setting here.

settings.renodx_enable_hdr_rules_description: The mod only gets HDR when the monitor is already in HDR. Turns on the HDR rule for the game, and on Hyprland, with hypr-hdr installed, the rule that switches the monitor.

The default sets the overlay key to F10, because many keyboards have no Home key, ReShade's own default. The value is virtual key, ctrl, shift, alt.

settings.optiscaler_auto_install: Install OptiScaler automatically in games that support it

settings.optiscaler_optipatcher_description: <optipatcher>OptiPatcher</optipatcher> exposes DLSS inputs on AMD and Intel GPUs without GPU spoofing, which avoids the crashes and overhead spoofing can cause. Only installed in games the compatibility list marks as supported.

settings.optiscaler_proxy_dll_description: The DLL name the game loads OptiScaler through. Automatic picks one for each game: the name its OptiScaler wiki page lists, winmm.dll for a game that uses Vulkan (such a game loads dxgi.dll too late, so it gets dxgi.dll only when its wiki page names it), otherwise dxgi.dll, and never a name the game folder already has (a crack's winmm.dll, ReShade's dxgi.dll). Pick a name to use it for every game. Each game can override this.
settings.optiscaler_ini_overrides_description: Settings written into OptiScaler.ini on every install, in INI format. For example, [Menu] followed by ShortcutKey=0x78 opens the overlay with F9 instead of Insert. Changes made in the overlay are kept until OptiScaler is reinstalled or updated.

settings.prepare_online_fix_games_description: For games that use OnlineFix, Hydra loads its proxy DLLs (winmm.dll, version.dll, …) from the game folder and copies Steam's client files into the Wine prefix, which OnlineFix needs to start. The files come from your Steam install, a Windows Steam install on a mounted drive, or another prefix that already has them.
settings.post_install_command_description: Runs once per game, after its prefix is ready, from the game's folder. It receives HYDRA_GAME_TITLE, HYDRA_GAME_SHOP, HYDRA_GAME_OBJECT_ID, HYDRA_GAME_DIR, HYDRA_GAME_EXECUTABLE and, for Wine games, WINEPREFIX and PROTONPATH. Output goes to the post-install log in Hydra's logs folder.

settings.cloud_r2_guide_link: How do I set up Cloudflare R2?
settings.cloud_r2_guide_intro: R2 is Cloudflare's S3-compatible storage. At the time of writing its free tier covers 10 GB of storage with no download fees, far more than game saves need. Cloudflare asks for a payment method to enable R2 even when you stay in the free tier; check their pricing page for current limits.
settings.cloud_r2_step_enable_body: Sign in to the Cloudflare dashboard (a free account is fine), open R2 Object Storage and enable it.
settings.cloud_r2_step_bucket_body: Choose Create bucket and name it, for example:
settings.cloud_r2_step_token_body: On the R2 overview page choose Manage API tokens, then Create API token. Give it Object Read & Write permission and limit it to your bucket. Copy the Access Key ID, the Secret Access Key (shown once) and the S3 endpoint, which looks like https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com.
settings.cloud_r2_step_rclone_body: Hydra reaches R2 through rclone. On Arch and CachyOS:
settings.cloud_r2_step_remote_body: Run rclone config file to find rclone.conf, then add this block with your own values. no_check_bucket stops rclone from trying to create the bucket, which a token limited to one bucket is not allowed to do.
settings.cloud_r2_step_check_body: This should finish without an error. An empty bucket prints nothing.
settings.cloud_r2_step_connect_body: Paste the values from the token page. Hydra adds a remote named hydra-r2 to your rclone config (downloading rclone first if it is missing), checks that it can write to the bucket, and turns save sync on. The keys stay in rclone's config, not in Hydra.
settings.cloud_r2_step_manual: Prefer to set rclone up yourself? Add a remote with rclone config, then enter it under An rclone remote. Use the same remote on your other devices.
settings.cloud_r2_account_id_hint: The 32 characters in the S3 endpoint, https://<account id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
settings.cloud_r2_connected: Save sync is on with Cloudflare R2
settings.cloud_r2_bad_account_id: That is not an account ID: it is 32 letters and digits.
settings.cloud_r2_connect_failed: Could not reach the bucket. Check the keys, the bucket name and that the token may write to it.
settings.cloud_r2_step_hydra_body: Close this window, choose An rclone remote, enter r2:hydra-saves and select Turn on. On your other devices, repeat the rclone steps with the same remote name, then enter the same value.
settings.cloud_r2_secret_warning: Keep the secret key private. If it leaks, delete the token in Cloudflare and create a new one.

mods.installed_hint: Mods are linked into {{folder}}; turning one off or removing it puts the game's own files back.

mods.installed_empty: No mods yet. Install one from Nexus Mods, or from an archive you downloaded.
mods.updates_found_zero: Every mod is up to date.
mods.fomod_hint: This mod was installed before Hydra offered installer options, as packed. Install it again to choose its options.
mods.overridden_one: {{count}} file replaced by a mod below
mods.order_hint: When two mods ship the same file, the one lower in the list wins.
mods.nexus_hint: Mods for {{game}} on Nexus Mods. No Nexus account needed: files download through TorBox.
mods.nexus_no_game: This game wasn't found on Nexus Mods by its title. Search for it:
mods.nexus_failed: Nexus Mods could not be reached. Try again later.
mods.no_torbox: Nexus Mods downloads go through TorBox, so they need your TorBox token in Settings → Integrations. Without it, open a file on Nexus Mods, download it there, and use Install from file.
mods.no_files: This mod has no files to download.
mods.mod_page: Open the mod's page on Nexus Mods
mods.error_no_torbox: Add your TorBox token in Settings to download from Nexus Mods.
mods.error_torbox_failed: TorBox could not fetch the file from Nexus Mods. It limits Nexus downloads per day; Settings → Mods shows how many are left.
mods.error_extract_failed: The archive could not be unpacked.
mods.error_no_game_folder: The game has no executable yet, so there is no folder for mods.
mods.error_game_running: Close the game first: mods can't change while it runs.
mods.error_not_found: The game is no longer in the library.
mods.error_failed: Something went wrong. The log has the details.
mods.nxm_hint: Nexus Mods' own Mod Manager Download buttons can install straight into Hydra too.
mods.nxm_no_game: {{game}} isn't in your library with an executable, so the mod has nowhere to go.
mods.requirements_missing_hint: Its Nexus page lists these as required and they are not in this list. Ignore it if you installed them another way.
mods.fomod_no_steps: This installer has no options; Install adds its files.
mods.fomod_pick_hint: Point at an option to see what it does.
mods.fomod_chosen_hint: Installed through its installer with the options you picked.
mods.profile_new_hint: Save the list as it is now as a profile; changes then go into the active profile, and switching profiles swaps which mods are on and their order.
mods.play_plain_hint: Starts the game unmodded: Hydra takes the mods out of the game folder first. Play (modded) puts them back.
mods.play_modded_hint: Starts the game with its mods in the game folder.
mods.play_modded_hint_loader: Starts the game through {{loader}} with its mods.
mods.save_backup_description: Mods can change saves, and some changes can't be undone by turning the mod off. Hydra can back up this game's saves once before its first modded launch.
mods.save_backup_failed: The save backup didn't finish, so the game wasn't started. Settings → Cloud has the details.
mods.support_fallback_table: Hydra places files in {{folder}}; it doesn't know this game's loader or mod list yet.
mods.support_fallback_root: Hydra places files in {{folder}}, since it has no entry for this game; it doesn't know the game's loader or mod list yet.
mods.support_definition: {{name}}, from {{from}}: loose mod files go into {{folder}}.
mods.support_definition_loader: {{name}}, from {{from}}: loose mod files go into {{folder}} and load through {{loader}}.
mods.support_definition_unsupported_loader: {{name}}, from {{from}}: loose mod files go into {{folder}}. Its mods load through {{loader}}, which Hydra can't install yet.
mods.reshade_needed: ReShade with add-on support is needed for its add-ons
mods.reshade_needed_hint: A mod in the list is a ReShade add-on. Hydra didn't install ReShade on its own (the Activity tab says why); Options → Tools has it once installed.
mods.reshade_installed: ReShade installed. Its overlay opens with F10.
mods.loader_needed: {{loader}} is needed for mods to load
mods.loader_needed_hint: Hydra installs it with the first mod that needs it, or now.
mods.loader_needed_missing_hint: Mods in the list need it and it isn't on.
mods.placement_reason_contains-program: The archive holds a program. Hydra never runs one from a mod, so it asks instead of guessing; the description may say what to do with it.
mods.placement_reason_nothing-recognised: Nothing in it matches this game's mod folders or file types, so Hydra doesn't know where it goes.
mods.placement_reason_loose-in-game-folder: Its files would go loose into the game folder and match nothing there, so Hydra asks instead of guessing.
mods.placement_reason_user: Pick where each part goes. The mod is installed again in its place.
mods.placement_programs: Programs in the archive (Hydra won't run them): {{files}}
mods.placement_no_description: No description: the mod was installed from a file.
mods.placement_example: The description says where these go: keep this as an example so Hydra learns to read it
mods.placement_waiting: Hydra isn't sure where its files go
mods.order_sort_description: Mods that others depend on load first, so the mods that need them win the files they share. Hydra read this from the mods' Nexus requirements, the loader and the manifests inside them. Moving mods by hand afterwards keeps your order.
mods.order_no_moves: The order is already right; nothing moves.
mods.order_cycle: These mods depend on each other in a circle, so they keep their order: {{names}}.
mods.order_already_sorted: The mods are already in dependency order.
mods.order_sort_failed: Hydra couldn't work out the dependency order. The log has the details.
mods.loader_badge_hint: The game's mod loader. Play (modded) loads it through {{dlls}}; Play takes it out with the other mods.
mods.mods_taken_out: Play is this game's default, so its mods are out of the game folder. Play (modded) puts them back.
mods.error_proxy_dll_clash: The loader uses the same DLL as another tool in this game (OptiScaler, ReShade or OnlineFix). The Activity tab says which.
mods.error_no_loader_package: Hydra doesn't know where to get this game's loader.
mods.report_copied: Mods report copied. Paste it into Claude Code or a bug report.
mods.report_failed: The mods report could not be made. The log has the details.
mods.folder_open_failed: The folder could not be opened.
mods.load_failed: The game's mods could not be loaded.
mods.blocker_game_running: The game is running. Close it to change its mods.
mods.blocker_no_executable: Set the game's executable first: mods go into its folder.
mods.download_state_done_options: Downloaded; it waits for your choices on the Mods page
mods.activity_load_failed: The activity log could not be read.
mods.activity_empty: Nothing has happened yet. Installs, downloads, changes to the list and modded launches show up here.
mods.download_retry_failed: The download could not be restarted.
mods.settings_load_failed: The mod settings could not be loaded.
mods.settings_description: Mods are installed per game from its Mods page. These settings cover where downloads come from and where mods are kept.
mods.settings_torbox_links: Nexus Mods files download through TorBox: {{left}} of {{limit}} Nexus downloads left today.
mods.settings_torbox_links_unknown: Nexus Mods files download through TorBox. How many Nexus downloads are left today could not be read.
mods.settings_torbox_missing: Nexus Mods files download through TorBox, which isn't set up. Without it, each file opens on Nexus Mods for a manual download and Install from file.
mods.settings_nxm_on: Nexus Mods' Mod Manager Download buttons install straight into Hydra.
mods.settings_nxm_off: Nexus Mods' Mod Manager Download buttons open another app, or nothing.
mods.nxm_register_failed: Hydra could not be set as the handler for those buttons.
